envelope.description: Add the initTabs controller to js/tui.js

body.title: Add the initTabs controller to js/tui.js
body.summary: Add a self-contained initTabs() to the IIFE, appended to the existing DOMContentLoaded call list beside initTheme/initCopy WITHOUT modifying them. It queries the tablist, returns early (no-op) when absent, marks the container active, wires tab click + Left/Right/Home/End arrow-key selection, toggles aria-selected on tabs + hidden on panels, defaults to the first tab (Terminal), and activates the tab matching location.hash when it names a panel.
acceptanceChecks: initTabs no-ops when no [role=tablist] is present (every other page is unaffected).
Click + arrow-key (Left/Right/Home/End) selection toggles aria-selected + panel hidden correctly; focus is visible.
The existing initTheme/initCopy/initAnchors handlers are unchanged and still run.
A location.hash naming a panel activates that tab; otherwise the first tab is active.

tests.name: click each tab shows its panel + toggles aria-selected/hidden; keyboard Left/Right/Home/End + visible focus
initTabs no-ops on pages without a tablist (index.html, cli.html theme/copy unaffected)
location.hash naming a panel activates that tab; else first tab (Terminal)
